answer: In decentralized consensus, identity crystallizes like a slow glacier: deep trust hardens only through enduring verification epochs. A hostile swarm may kick up a sudden gale of ephemeral clones, but their weight is bounded. Through transitive stake-decay algorithms, voting weight compounds with sustained interaction history, forcing superlinear capital costs on adversaries. A fresh puppet creates merely a faint ripple across the frozen bedrock, leaving the network unyielding against fleeting counterfeits.
